name: ru.paydadosh/dictionary
title: PaydaDosh — Ingush dictionary
description: Ingush–Russian dictionary: lookup, word analysis, paradigms, corpus examples, text checks

tools.name: search_dictionary
tools.description: Look up a word in PaydaDosh, the Ingush–Russian dictionary (headwords merged from dozens of printed dictionaries). Works both ways: Ingush → Russian («дог», «кӀант», «гӀалгӀай») and Russian → Ingush («сердце», «закрыть», «спасибо»; inflected Russian forms are reduced to the dictionary form). Palochka may be typed as I, 1, l or |. Returns headwords with part of speech, Russian definition, the codes of the printed sources and a link to the word page; for Russian queries also entries of Ozdoev's Russian–Ingush dictionary (ОЗД80). If the query is an inflected Ingush form, `wordform_of` names its lemma — call analyze_word for the full analysis. found=false means the dictionary has no such word: say so, do not invent one.

query.description: Ingush or Russian word or short phrase, e.g. «дог», «кӀант», «гӀалгӀай», «сердце», «закрыть».
query.title: Query

direction.description: auto (default) detects the language; ing_to_rus — the query is Ingush; rus_to_ing — Russian.
direction.title: Direction

tools.name: analyze_word
tools.description: Morphological analysis of one Ingush word form: lemma, part of speech, grammatical description (case, number, tense, mood…), confidence (high / medium / hypothesis), morpheme segmentation, dictionary gloss and alternative analyses, plus up to 3 corpus examples with translation. Examples: «дегаш» (plural of «дог» 'heart'), «аргдий», «цӀагӀа». If the form is unknown, returns found=false with spelling suggestions — do not invent a form.

tools.name: get_paradigm
tools.description: Inflection table of an Ingush word — noun cases and numbers, verb tenses and moods, adjective forms — as on the word page of paydadosh.ru. `word` is always required: a lemma or any form («дог», «дегаш», «ала»); entry_id from search_dictionary additionally picks the homonym. Every form has a reliability tier: verified (checked by a moderator or native speaker), dictionary (printed in a dictionary), corpus (attested in texts), rule (generated by rules, not attested — may be wrong), auto (filled automatically, unchecked). Rows of verbs (and free adjective forms) carry the class row `cls` {в, й, б, д: form} as on the word card — pick the class of the absolutive; nouns carry `noun_class` with singular and plural class. main_only=true returns only the principal rows.

word.description: Ingush lemma or any of its forms, e.g. «дог», «дегаш», «ала», «кӀант».
word.title: Word

part_of_speech.description: Pick the table type when the word is both, e.g. «ала» (verb 'to say' / noun 'flame').
part_of_speech.title: Part Of Speech

entry_id.description: Optional id of a headword from search_dictionary — picks the right homonym.
entry_id.title: Entry Id

main_only.description: Only the principal rows (verbs: infinitive, masdar, present, past, perfect, future, negatives, imperative, converbs, participles) — a verb table otherwise has 100+ rows.
main_only.title: Main Only

tools.name: find_examples
tools.description: Up to 5 sentences from the PaydaDosh corpus of Ingush texts (books, press, folklore) with the word or its forms, with Russian translation where available (translation: verified / published / draft / none) and the source. First page of results only; the full list is on the site (url). Sentences are short quotations from copyrighted publications — always cite the source. Examples: «дог», «бӀаргаш».

word.description: Ingush word (its forms are found too) or a Russian word to look up in translations, e.g. «дог», «бӀаргаш», «сердце».
word.title: Word

tools.name: translation_context
tools.description: Everything PaydaDosh knows that is relevant to translating a phrase or answering a question about Ingush — the same material the site's own assistant reads before answering: native-speaker corrections approved by the editors (use them verbatim), ready phrasebook phrases (check the occasion), parallel Ingush–Russian sentences from the corpus, dictionary entries, Ozdoev's Russian–Ingush dictionary with its phraseology, grammar notes and native speakers' answers from the Q&A section «Хаттараш». Call it FIRST for any phrase translation (Russian → Ingush or Ingush → Russian), e.g. «Как сказать „я хочу домой“?», «Мел ха яьннай хьа?». Heavier than other tools: limited to 20 calls per minute.

question.description: The user's question or phrase as is, e.g. «Как сказать „я хочу домой“?», «Мел ха яьннай хьа?», «как ты себя чувствуешь».
question.title: Question

tools.name: check_ingush_text
tools.description: Verify an Ingush text — typically your own draft answer before you send it — with exactly the check the site's own assistant applies to its answers. Every Ingush word gets a verdict: confirmed (found in the dictionary, spelling lexicon, a card's form table, a confident analyzer reading, the corpus, the phrasebook or native speakers' corrections and answers) or unverified (not confirmed anywhere — likely an error or an invented form, with suggestions). Russian words in the text are skipped. Confirmed words come with the analyzer's reading (lemma, part of speech, note), and with a gloss and card link only when the card is unambiguous. Quotes attributed to a source that are not in the data are listed in unverified_quotes. Replace or flag every unverified word instead of presenting it as Ingush. Example: «Сона хьо веза, хьо са дог ва». Only the unverified words are kept in our log, not the text.

text.description: Ingush text to verify — typically your own draft answer; Russian words in it are recognised and skipped. The first 1000 characters are checked. E.g. «Сона хьо веза, хьо са дог ва».
text.title: Text

tools.name: check_spelling
tools.description: Spell-check a person's Ingush text (up to 1000 characters) with the PaydaDosh spelling dictionary. Returns each problematic word with its position, kind (error; palochka typed with a wrong letter; rare form; Russian word) and suggestions, class-agreement grammar warnings and, for short phrases, a corrected phrase. Example: «Со гӀалгӀай ва». Only the misspelled words are kept in our log, not the text.

text.description: Ingush text; the first 1000 characters are checked. E.g. «Со гӀалгӀай ва», «Сона хьо веза».
text.title: Text
